situation.topPattern: The Russia sanctions waiver is the load-bearing event: it simultaneously degrades NATO deterrence, emboldens Chinese coercive diplomacy in the Philippines by signaling US alliance unreliability, pressures Hormuz oil routes by scrambling Western energy sanctions architecture, and hands Democrats a midterm weapon at a moment when Kalshi markets already price Republican House retention as a coin flip — all while the White House loses its communications director within days, creating a credibility vacuum at maximum strategic exposure
